description: Use this when an owner on the gym plan wants to change the card, see invoices or change how many places the plan covers. It returns a link to Stripe's own billing page for the owner to open. It is a link only: nothing is paid or changed in the chat, and it changes nothing by itself. It needs a connected Phorme account.
name: get_gym_billing_link

billing_url.description: Stripe's own billing page, or null when it opens from the console.

console_url.description: The Plan tab of the console on phor.me.

title: Get my gym billing link
